name: Denormalizer

suggests.drupal/webform: Adds webform_submission source support, flattening webform elements (including multi-value and likert) into denormalized columns.
suggests.drupal/duration_field: Renders the cron 'Run every' / 'Reload every' settings as duration widgets instead of raw seconds.

project_description: Denormalizer flattens Drupal content entities (and webform submissions) into plain, denormalized SQL tables so business-intelligence and ETL tools can consume Drupal data without knowing Drupal internals such as how fields are joined. Admins define 'Denormalizer table' config entities that pick an entity type, bundle, and the base/bundle fields to include; the module then creates a dedicated 'denormalizer_<id>' table, populates it in a batch, and keeps it in sync on entity insert/update/delete through a queue worker and on cron. It is a developer/BI data-transformation tool inspired by the ETL module but taking a different, load-free approach.
